reports.title: Aflac Incorporated Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results,

lines: Aflac Japan's underlying earned premiums1 – which excludes the impact of reinsurance, paid-up policies and deferred profit liability – declined 1.2%, roughly in line with where we expect to be for the full year.

Recognizing that the year-to-date benefit ratio is 58.8%, we now expect for 2026 that the benefit ratio in Japan will be slightly below the 60% to 63% range, and we expect the expense ratio to be on the lower end of the 20% to 23% range.

In the U.S., we expect the benefit ratio for 2026 to be below the 48% to 52% range and the expense ratio to be in the middle of the 36% to 39% range as we continue to scale network dental and group life and disability.
At the same time, we expect pretax profit margin for 2026 in the U.S. to be above the 17% to 20% range.
